column1: # Flags: rules kept in their jurisdiction's own column but left out of the reference by default (judge --flagged).
# A rule is flagged when a word of its text names a status that sets a party apart (slave or free, gender,
# religion or people, foreigner), or when its penalty is one the main human-rights instruments forbid or work to
# abolish: corporal and mutilating punishment (ICCPR art. 7, the Convention against Torture), cruel modes of
# execution, and the death penalty (the ICCPR's Second Optional Protocol, ECHR Protocol 13). Words, not judgments:
# a flag says where to look, and errs on the side of flagging.
